are divided into three types for

(2) Protected Forests and

3 . On the basis of ownership. administration and
management. forests are divided into three
types : (1 l State Forest. (2) Communal Forest
and (3) Private Forest.

8 . Wildlife Diversity: There is a large diversity
among the insects, animals , birds and
vegetation due to physiographical diversity in
India. There are about 15 lakh species of
birds and animals in the world. Out of it,
about 81,251 species are found in India.
India holds twelfth rank in terms of biodiversity. Wildlife of all the three continents
Asia, Europe and Africa are found in India.

4. Deforestation means the destruction of forests.
Deforestation is a problem not only of our
country but is one of the global problems.
5. Main reasons for the destruction of forests by

man in India are population increase, desire to
get more land for agriculture, industrialization,
establishing new settlements, acts to get more
wood for buildings and fuel , poverty among the
forest dwellers, jhoom agriculture, construction
of railway. roads and airports , the policy to
start industrial establishments away from the
city, multipurpose projects, construction of
canals and forest fire , etc.

Animals like African hyena, chinkara,
European wolf, wild goats , Kashmiri deer,
African elephants, gibbons and monkeys are
found in India. Black bear, one horned rhino,
deer, snakes, king cobra, sea turtles, snow
leopard are found in Himalayas, red panda
is found in cold forests. These are distinct
animals of Indian bio-diversity. Tigers and lions
move in their natural habitats. Migratory birds
come to Keoladev National Park in Rajasthan
and to Nal Sarovar in Gujarat during Winter.

6 . Impact of Deforestation : Some adverse results
are experienced, such as the increase in
pollution due to the destruction of forests ,
decrease in rainfall, droughts, soil erosion, wild
animals losing their habitats, some animals
becoming extinct, global warming, problem
arising out of greenhouse effects, loss of natural
beauty. rivers getting flooded, etc.

9 . Wildlife on Extinction : Today, danger prevails
over many wild animals about their existence.
These are getting extinct. Cheetah has been
extinct from the Indian forests . The existence
of lion, tiger, snow leopard. vulture. pink
throated duck, crane. owl. chilotro. musk deer.
